instruction: By when should everything from my yesterday's amazon order arrive? Tell me the date in DD-MM format.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only has read-only lookup actions plus logins. The agent lists orders to locate yesterday's order (placed-yesterday is a static selection fact), fetches its details to find the latest delivery date across all items, and reports that date (DD-MM) as the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task. The goal requires the delivery date to have been found for yesterday's order and the task to be completed; supervisor-complete-task is forced last because every other action requires (not (task-completed)).
